cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. One last cup to dry before your taxi arrives.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Could you reach the shelf for it? I'll fetch your coat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's away. The driver's calling; I really have to go.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you put him on speaker first? I should thank him for waiting. What's his name?

mechanism: A keeps a pupil present by converting each completed household favor into the next lesson in finishing or courtesy.
confusable: Each request remains small and triggered by departure pressure rather than announcing a large chore.
comparison: Checking domestic controls versus manners around a waiting driver.
seedUse: Use D26 cup/shelf/driver-call sequence; S05 claims of taught completeness and courtesy make the extra tasks seem supervisory.
